summary: Backend API testing for Rustic Bakes: 40 pytest cases across products, categories, content, auth (register/login/me/profile/orders), inquiries, admin CRUD (products/categories/media/content/orders), stats, payment settings, auth guards (401/403), and Stripe checkout+status. All 40 tests pass. Stripe checkout with currency='inr' verified; order persisted with user_id and returned in /auth/orders. Placeholder Resend key does not error (send_inquiry_email guarded).

minor.issue: Email is silently lowercased. Fine, but not documented in response contract; test had to adjust for lowercase.
Unknown keys return 200 with empty value dict instead of 404 — acceptable but noteworthy.
Accepts arbitrary dict without Pydantic model; no validation of currency/provider.
allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=False — OK for token auth, but wildcard is broad.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~600 lines — still manageable but approaching the 700-line split threshold; consider modularizing (auth, products, admin, payments).
get_optional_user swallows all HTTPExceptions including 500-caused ones; acceptable but log the reason for observability.
PUT /auth/profile accepts a raw dict (no Pydantic model) — allows arbitrary fields to be silently ignored; should use a Pydantic ProfileUpdate model.
PUT /admin/orders/{id} & PUT /admin/payment-settings both accept raw dict — add Pydantic models for validation.
Stripe webhook returns 200 with body {'status':'error'} on failure — Stripe will treat it as delivered; consider 400 for signature failures.
No rate limiting or brute-force lockout on /auth/login (playbook mentions 5-fail lockout).
resend/stripe module-level api_key assignment tightly couples config; safe here because keys are placeholders.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed users, products, categories, media, inquiries via API. Not cleaned up (documented for future).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully passing. Stripe checkout creates a real session against sk_test_emergent via emergentintegrations — network call takes ~1-2s. /auth/orders correctly returns only current user's orders. Frontend testing not yet performed (backend-only request). Use test_credentials.md for admin.
